WORKSPACE_APPS.TITLE: Applications
WORKSPACE_APPS.EMPTY: No applications have been added. A company administrator can add the systems your team uses.
WORKSPACE_APPS.DESCRIPTION: Add company applications and control access. Each user keeps their own applications open while returning to conversations.
WORKSPACE_APPS.NAME: Application name
WORKSPACE_APPS.ICON_HELP: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 1 MB. Transparency is preserved.
WORKSPACE_APPS.ICON_ERROR: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image up to 1 MB.
WORKSPACE_APPS.ACCESS_HELP: Company administrators retain management access and access to enabled applications.
WORKSPACE_APPS.AUTH_NOTICE: HUB does not read or capture external login forms. In normal login mode, the destination manages authentication and its session.
WORKSPACE_APPS.ALLOW_SAVE: Allow each user to save their own credentials
WORKSPACE_APPS.ALLOW_AUTO: Allow automatic login with user consent
WORKSPACE_APPS.POST_HELP: Use POST only with a compatible, authorized destination endpoint. Dynamic CSRF tokens, CAPTCHA, multi-factor authentication and identity-provider flows require a destination-specific integration. These protections are not discovered automatically or bypassed.
WORKSPACE_APPS.CHANGE_WARNING: Changing the URL or login configuration invalidates saved credentials and old tabs. Name or icon changes alone preserve tabs.
WORKSPACE_APPS.DELETE_WARNING: The application and its saved credentials will be removed from this company. Open tabs close on the next permission refresh.
WORKSPACE_APPS.SAVE_ERROR: Unable to save. Check HTTPS URLs, access permissions and authentication configuration.
WORKSPACE_APPS.BACK_TO_HUB: Return to HUB without closing the application
WORKSPACE_APPS.EMBED_HELP: The destination must allow embedding. If the page or login is blocked, use “Open in browser”.
WORKSPACE_APPS.CREDENTIAL_NOTICE: Enter this application’s credentials, not your HUB password. Credentials are saved only with your consent and are never shared with other users.
WORKSPACE_APPS.REMEMBER: Save my credentials, encrypted on the server
WORKSPACE_APPS.AUTO_LOGIN: Log in automatically on future openings
WORKSPACE_APPS.NATIVE_LOGIN: Sign in using the application’s own page
WORKSPACE_APPS.CREDENTIAL_ERROR: Unable to read or update your credentials.
WORKSPACE_APPS.LOGIN_ERROR: Unable to prepare login. The configuration may have changed. Try again or use the application’s own login page.
WORKSPACE_APPS.CONFIRM_MESSAGE: This ends the current instance and may discard unsaved changes. To return to conversations without closing, use “Return to HUB”.
WORKSPACE_APPS.NAV_UNAVAILABLE: This site has not enabled integrated navigation. Use its own controls or configure the optional navigation bridge.
WORKSPACE_APPS.NETWORK_OFFLINE: The browser is offline. The application remains open.
WORKSPACE_APPS.LOCAL_POLICY_ERROR: The HUB security policy blocked this destination.
WORKSPACE_APPS.LOAD_UNCONFIRMED: Loading has not yet been confirmed. This does not prove a site failure.
WORKSPACE_APPS.DIAG_SCOPE: Server-side check without login, passwords or cookies. Headers may differ from your browser response. An iframe does not expose all errors to HUB. This check does not interrupt the application.
WORKSPACE_APPS.DIAG_ORIGIN: HUB origin to authorize at the destination
WORKSPACE_APPS.DIAG_FAILED: Unable to obtain diagnostics. Check your HUB connection and access permission.
WORKSPACE_APPS.DIAG_ORIGIN_MISMATCH: The server origin differs from this browser origin. Check FRONTEND_URL and the HUB proxy. Checked origin:
WORKSPACE_APPS.DIAG_REPORT_ONLY: A Report-Only policy was found. It reports violations but does not itself block the page.
WORKSPACE_APPS.DIAG_FIX_POLICY: At the destination server, authorize the exact HUB origin in frame-ancestors. Example directive:
WORKSPACE_APPS.DIAG_FIX_KEEP: Update this directive in the existing policy; do not replace the entire CSP. Check application, proxy and CDN headers: additional policies still apply. Conflicting X-Frame-Options must be handled at the destination. Do not disable global security or certificate validation.
WORKSPACE_APPS.DIAG_FIX_NETWORK: For DNS, TLS or refused connections, check the address, certificate, proxy and destination availability. Changing User-Agent or allowing CORS does not fix an embedding restriction. Login may require cookies or a dedicated integration.
WORKSPACE_APPS.DIAG_BROWSER_CONSOLE: For the exact browser error, open F12 → Console/Network and repeat loading. Look for frame-ancestors, X-Frame-Options, frame-src or net::ERR_. For third-party systems, ask the owner to authorize embedding or open in the browser.

DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.dns_error: The HUB server could not resolve the destination hostname.
DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.tls_error: TLS negotiation or certificate validation failed on the HUB server.
DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.timeout: The destination did not respond within the 8-second limit.
DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.connection_refused: The connection from HUB to the destination was refused.
DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.network_error: A network or protocol error occurred during the server check.
DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.blocked_address: Diagnostics were not run: private, local and reserved addresses are blocked for safety. This does not prevent browser access.
DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalid_url: The destination or redirect is not an accepted HTTPS URL.
DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.redirect_limit: Redirects could not be completed within the check limit.
DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.http_status: The destination returned the HTTP status below to HEAD. Browser access may differ.

DIAGNOSTIC_VERDICTS.blocked: The checked response restricts embedding by the configured HUB origin.
DIAGNOSTIC_VERDICTS.no_block_observed: No restriction was identified in the checked headers. This does not confirm page or login compatibility.
DIAGNOSTIC_VERDICTS.inconclusive: The checked headers do not support a reliable conclusion.
